description: Defines the ThemeVariables class in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin, encapsulating theme-related color and gradient properties with getters and a factory method.

classes.name: ThemeVariables
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing theme color variables, with encapsulated properties and a static factory method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ThemeVariables object with specific color and gradient properties.

methods.name: getPrimaryColor
methods.description: Returns the primary color of the theme.

methods.name: getPrimaryFontColor
methods.description: Returns the font color used with the primary color.

methods.name: getSecondaryColor
methods.description: Returns the secondary color of the theme.

methods.name: getSecondaryFontColor
methods.description: Returns the font color used with the secondary color.

methods.name: getPrimaryGradientStartColor
methods.description: Returns the starting color of the primary gradient.

methods.name: getPrimaryGradientEndColor
methods.description: Returns the ending color of the primary gradient.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a ThemeVariables object from an associative array of properties.
